description: Conservative current-day ordinary-reply exposure opportunities on all 640 existing paired tactical runs. Both sides use the same runtime policy in each case. Every pre-existing non-timing result matches the preserved original report exactly. Counterfactual commands and forecasts run only in observer-enabled diagnostic replays; every replay also matches the complete unobserved game state including RNG. This is a bounded static-board opportunity measurement, not a claim of globally dominated moves, actual casualties saved or causal policy strength.
execution: Eight reports executed concurrently; new timing values are not performance evidence. Earlier isolated tactical and performance measurements remain separately preserved.

configuration.description: Both armies use the runtime policy; each fixture swaps armies and control seat. Actual campaign ration charging follows each tactical day. Synthetic contact/choke/water fixtures are labelled; river-crossing uses the unchanged canvas map. Field retention excludes later capture and return settlement.
configuration.instrumentation: A Vite-only transform exposes the existing ration charger and observes cloned pre-action states. Every measured day is rerun with observation, and the complete result including RNG must match. Timing uses the observer-disabled execution; existing performance gates remain separate.

metrics.dominatedFire: A Fire cast has a legal ordinary hit on the same target with no forecast counterattack and damage at least the maximum Fire forecast. Excludes an Inspired source because conserving its pending bonus may have value.
metrics.wastedSupport: Rally on an already-inspired, full-morale target; Confuse on an already-confused target; or a zero-transfer supply raid. These are narrow proven-no-gain checks, not all strategic waste.
metrics.retaliation: Sum of the shared ordinary-hit forecasts at actual primary attack decisions; distinct from actual casualties.
metrics.idle: An unresolved day without an attack or tactic. Stalled also has no movement and no confusion activation. Ending-only rout/retreat checks are excluded. These counts do not prove every hold was mistaken.

unnecessaryExposure.definition: For an observed ordinary attack, enumerate all destinations legal at its observed movement origin. Replay the same target attack with actual deterministic commands. Require identical unit effects (except actor position/spent movement), outcome, food, points and RNG. Preserve every other friendly formation’s current reachable cells and never increase any friendly unit’s largest legal current-day normal reply. Report a strictly smaller largest reply to the actor.
unnecessaryExposure.horizon: Only unspent enemy activations on the current board/day; actual moved, acted, Confuse, rout, occupancy, ZOC, terrain and water rules apply. Replies are independent possibilities, not a simultaneous attack sequence or predictions of what the opponent will choose.
unnecessaryExposure.limits: A conservative positional opportunity, not proof that a move is globally dominated. Future turns, tactics, supply, timeout strategy and subsequent allied actions can change its value. Tactic/hold decisions are outside coverage; skipped ordinary attacks have explicit reasons. Casualty reductions are forecast opportunities, not observed lives saved.

Synthetic contact/choke/water fixtures are labelled; river-crossing uses the unchanged canvas map. Field retention excludes later capture and return settlement.
configuration.instrumentation: A Vite-only transform exposes the existing ration charger and observes cloned pre-action states. Every measured day is rerun with observation, and the complete result including RNG must match. Timing uses the observer-disabled execution; existing performance gates remain separate.

metrics.dominatedFire: A Fire cast has a legal ordinary hit on the same target with no forecast counterattack and damage at least the maximum Fire forecast. Excludes an Inspired source because conserving its pending bonus may have value.
metrics.wastedSupport: Rally on an already-inspired, full-morale target; Confuse on an already-confused target; or a zero-transfer supply raid. These are narrow proven-no-gain checks, not all strategic waste.
metrics.retaliation: Sum of the shared ordinary-hit forecasts at actual primary attack decisions; distinct from actual casualties.
metrics.idle: An unresolved day without an attack or tactic. Stalled also has no movement and no confusion activation. Ending-only rout/retreat checks are excluded. These counts do not prove every hold was mistaken.

unnecessaryExposure.definition: For an observed ordinary attack, enumerate all destinations legal at its observed movement origin. Replay the same target attack with actual deterministic commands. Require identical unit effects (except actor position/spent movement), outcome, food, points and RNG. Preserve every other friendly formation’s current reachable cells and never increase any friendly unit’s largest legal current-day normal reply. Report a strictly smaller largest reply to the actor.
unnecessaryExposure.horizon: Only unspent enemy activations on the current board/day; actual moved, acted, Confuse, rout, occupancy, ZOC, terrain and water rules apply. Replies are independent possibilities, not a simultaneous attack sequence or predictions of what the opponent will choose.
unnecessaryExposure.limits: A conservative positional opportunity, not proof that a move is globally dominated. Future turns, tactics, supply, timeout strategy and subsequent allied actions can change its value. Tactic/hold decisions are outside coverage; skipped ordinary attacks have explicit reasons. Casualty reductions are forecast opportunities, not observed lives saved.
